hack.root_cause: Fee Accounting Bug — LP Token Transfer Without Reward Checkpoint
hack.description: Popsicle Finance's Sorbetto Fragola contract lost ~$20M when an attacker exploited a known LP token transfer fee-accounting bug — chaining three contracts to triple-collect the same rewards across eight Uniswap V3 pools simultaneously.
